key.name: keep-open-after-insert
key.summary: Keep the panel open after inserting an emoji
key.description: Shift+Enter / Shift+Click inverts this for a single insertion.

key.name: clipboard-history-enabled
key.summary: Keep a clipboard history in the Clipboard tab
key.description: Read-only monitoring: copied text is listed here, and picking an entry types it (X11 XTest) without touching the clipboard. Nothing is ever written to the clipboard.

key.name: clipboard-persist
key.summary: Save the clipboard history on disk
key.description: Off by default. When on, the copied texts kept in the history list (never your clipboard itself) are written unencrypted to $XDG_DATA_HOME/smile-panel/clipboard_history.json, readable by your user only (0600). Password-manager entries are always skipped.

key.name: key-delay-ms
key.summary: Delay in ms between keymap remap and key events (XTest)
